title: Countries & Capitals
description: How sharp is your memory for national capital cities across Europe, the Americas, Asia, and Oceania?
seoTitle: Countries & Capitals Quiz – Test Your World Capitals | AI Quiz Arena
seoDescription: Challenge yourself with 10 questions testing your knowledge of world capital cities from Australia to Canada.

questions.question: What is the federal capital city of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra was selected as a compromise site between rivals Sydney and Melbourne in 1908 to serve as the nation's capital.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Canada?
questions.explanation: Ottawa, located in Ontario along the border with Quebec, was chosen by Queen Victoria as the capital of Canada in 1857.

questions.question: What is the capital of Brazil?
questions.explanation: Brasília is a planned city inaugurated in 1960 to move the capital inland from Rio de Janeiro.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Switzerland?
questions.explanation: Bern serves as the de facto federal city and seat of the Swiss federal government (Bundesstadt).

questions.question: What is the capital of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Cairo is the sprawling capital of Egypt, situated along the banks of the Nile River.

questions.question: What is the capital city of New Zealand?
questions.explanation: Wellington, situated on the southern tip of the North Island, is the world's southernmost capital city.

questions.question: What is the capital of South Korea?
questions.explanation: Seoul is the vibrant capital and largest metropolis of the Republic of Korea (South Korea).

questions.question: What is the capital city of Kenya in East Africa?
questions.explanation: Nairobi is Kenya's capital and financial hub, famously known as the 'Green City in the Sun'.

questions.question: What is the capital of Turkey?
questions.explanation: Ankara was designated the capital of the Republic of Turkey by Mustafa Kemal Atatürk in 1923, succeeding Istanbul.

questions.question: What is the capital of Argentina?
questions.explanation: Buenos Aires is the cosmopolitan capital of Argentina, located on the western shore of the Río de la Plata estuary.
